subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Describe, compare and order numbers to 10
source.subtopic: Identify, read and write numbers, symbols and number names; ordinal position 1st-10th on the number line (weeks 9-10)

show.line: Ten ducks in a row! First, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth, tenth.

rounds.prompt: Tap the duck that is sixth in the row.
The last duck of ten. Which place is it? Say it.

hints: Count from the front. First, second, third.
Read the number word slowly. It starts like the number sounds.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find the seventh duck.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: One, two, three, four, five, six. This one is seventh!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I stopped at six. That duck is sixth. Seventh is next.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together. Six, and one more. That is the seventh!

parent_line: Can say first to tenth and read the number words to ten.
